bug: Original Molt2 deduplicated callbacks by batch plus stored program ID. Store merges identical genomes, so distinct evaluations of one program could be collapsed and leave best-of-two batch open.
fix: Key by timestamped measurement event and use that measurement metric for its credit. Exact redelivery remains idempotent.
tests: 109 passed across adaptive Molt2, native Molt/SimpleTES, core, persistence, upstream prompts; regression reproduces real Store genome deduplication and both measured results.
first_run_evidence: All80 recorded measurements belong to distinct individuals; neither event-collapse nor latest-reread metric ambiguity occurred.
legacy_primary_policy: Audit already-started legacy Molt2 runs for repeated measurements. Exclude affected or ambiguous legacy results from primary paired inference pending a recorded review/correction; retain raw traces. No score-based exclusion.
analysis_gate: Both final summary and paired inference retain raw results and withhold legacy Molt2 runs with repeat-event ambiguity until reviewed. Optional diagnostic failures are explicitly recorded instead of erasing primary paired results.
